section.name: tenant
section.title: TENANT CONFIGURATION
section.preamble: Each [tenant.<label>] section defines one provider served by the daemon. Choose a local label, such as work in [tenant.work], to identify its settings and select it with an account name such as alice@work. Configuration fragments using the same section name update the same provider. For Entra providers, domain identifies the stored credentials and server cache when a section label changes. .P Set domain for Microsoft Entra ID or oidc_issuer_url for OpenID Connect. Exactly one of these options defines the protocol of each provider. Okta backend selection is automatic within each OIDC provider. .P Set domain to an Entra provider's primary domain and domain_aliases to its other sign-in domains. The domain keys device credentials, the server cache and ID mapping. Preserve that value and idmap_range when converting an existing configuration. OIDC storage keys are derived from the issuer URL. .P With several providers, mark exactly one default = true and assign each a non-overlapping idmap_range. A single provider is the implicit default. Bare account names and cn_name_mapping use the default provider. The final @label explicitly selects a provider. For example, alice@example.org@partners selects [tenant.partners] with the upstream account alice@example.org. OIDC account claims retain their original spelling when sent to the provider. oidc_account_id_strip_at_suffix applies before adding the local provider label. .P OIDC accounts from tenant sections use account@label as their canonical Linux name, including accounts on the default provider. Entra accounts retain their UPN. Labels must be distinct from other providers' sign-in domains and aliases. Ambiguous routing is rejected. .P OIDC credentials are scoped by the issuer-derived tenant identity. Cached OIDC accounts and credentials are migrated when converting a legacy configuration or renaming a label, preserving numeric IDs, UUIDs and cached passwords. Preserve the issuer URL and idmap_range during conversion. Label changes change OIDC Linux account names: update name-based permissions and, when using name or spn home naming, move existing home directories to the new names. .P Provider settings override [global] settings. Discovered metadata is stored separately in /var/cache/himmelblaud/himmelblau.conf. Only administrator configuration defines providers. Unknown Entra aliases are accepted after their tenant ID is matched to a configured provider. .P Initialization and connectivity checks run independently for each provider. Initialization failures are logged and skipped; startup fails if none initialize. aad-tool status reports connectivity per provider. aad-tool --domain DOMAIN selects a provider for tenant-scoped commands; credential commands also accept --domain after the subcommand. The default provider is used when no account or domain is supplied. .P pam_allow_groups and sudo_groups are evaluated for the selected provider. Entra group rules use object IDs. OIDC pam_allow_groups also accepts group claims. Duplicate group display names retain separate UUIDs and memberships; ambiguous name lookups fail. Keep home directories distinct: CN home naming requires a separate home_prefix for each tenant sharing that naming scheme. Each home_prefix directory must already exist. .P When apply_policy is enabled, each Entra tenant enrolls and applies its Intune policy. Device-wide settings are shared: the last applied policy wins on conflicts. .P The daemon validates configuration at startup and with --configtest. It rejects mixed legacy/stanza definitions, duplicate domains, aliases or tenant identities, overlapping ID ranges, and multi-provider rfc2307 mappings.
section.subsection_intro: One section per provider; labels select providers in qualified login names.
section.example:
[tenant.contoso] domain = contoso.com domain_aliases = contoso.org default = true idmap_range = 200000-999999 home_prefix = /home/contoso/
[tenant.fabrikam] domain = fabrikam.com idmap_range = 1000000-1999999 home_prefix = /home/fabrikam/

[tenant.contoso] domain = contoso.com default = true idmap_range = 200000-999999 home_prefix = /home/contoso/
[tenant.partners] oidc_issuer_url = https://id.partners.example/realms/linux app_id = linux-login idmap_range = 1000000-1999999 home_prefix = /home/partners/ pam_allow_groups = linux-users
